clue.text: Back-slapping male with cultural pretensions

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
arty describes someone who parades artistic taste

explanation.surface: A jovial man who slaps backs while showing off his taste in the arts.
explanation.definitionFit: A back-slapping manner is loudly cheerful and effusive, which is what hearty describes.

clue.text: Virginia right to get a place in tough university

indicators.note: getting a place in something means being put inside it, so these letters go into the other word

parts.note: tough means hard
VA is the US postal abbreviation for Virginia

explanation.surface: A student from Virginia wins admission to a demanding university.
explanation.definitionFit: Harvard is the famous Ivy League university in Cambridge, Massachusetts, an example of the class.

clue.text: An old man with the twitch is listless

parts.note: an gives the indefinite article A
old man is slang for father, PA
taken as written
a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: An elderly fellow afflicted with a nervous twitch has no energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone lacking energy, interest or enthusiasm; they are synonyms.

clue.text: Holy place that may throb with intense activity

definitions.meaning: a building for worship, such as a shrine or church

definitions.text: that may throb with intense activity
definitions.meaning: the flat side of the head, where a pulse can be felt pounding under strain

explanation.surface: A shrine buzzing with busy worshippers.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is anatomical: the side of the forehead throbs when you are stressed or working hard.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a place of worship and the side of the head where a vein can pulse.

clue.text: It's plain Dad is going back and forth with payment

indicators.note: going back means this word for father is first read in the backwards direction

parts.note: dad is pa
dad is pa
rent is a regular payment for property

explanation.surface: It is obvious that father pays out to and fro with the rent money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and forth' is a link with no op of its own: Dad is read once backwards, then once forwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain in the sense of clear and obvious is a synonym of evident or manifest.

clue.text: Top dog, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken and we enter one that sounds the same

parts.note: a peke is a Pekingese dog

explanation.surface: The leading dog, for example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Top dog' looks like a single phrase meaning boss; split it into the definition and the dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A summit or highest point is the top of a mountain; the words are synonyms.

clue.text: Account provided once date has been amended

indicators.note: amended means altered, so the letters of the preceding words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A record supplied after a date has been changed.
explanation.definitionFit: A short story about an incident is an account of it; an anecdote is that kind of tale.

clue.text: Omit a vowel? I'd easily included it

indicators.note: included says the letters sit inside the run of words just before it, across the word breaks

parts.note: the clue describes slurring out a sound in speech, as when 'I would' is shortened to I'd

explanation.surface: Advice that dropping a vowel comes easily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Omit a vowel' reads as one definition, but only 'Omit' defines; 'vowel' is part of the run in which the letters sit.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave out a sound or syllable in speech is to omit it; the verbs are close synonyms.

clue.text: At that point, change for the theatre

indicators.note: change signals the letters of the following word are rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to switch to drama at a certain moment.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic adverb meaning there or at that place, and so at that point.

clue.text: Regions about to receive hand- outs

parts.note: re means about or concerning
alms are charitable gifts handed out to the poor

explanation.surface: Districts are poised to get charitable handouts.
explanation.definitionFit: Kingdoms and domains are regions or spheres; the words are synonyms.

clue.text: Shipping company after vessel for lubricant product

indicators.note: after places the shipping firm behind the vessel in the answer

parts.note: a vase is a vessel for flowers
a line is a company running ships on regular routes

explanation.surface: A shipping firm follows a ship in launching a lubricant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship beside 'shipping', but here it is a flower vase.
explanation.definitionFit: A branded petroleum jelly, used as a lubricant and skin ointment.

clue.text: Bones for stays

definitions.meaning: a corpse or skeleton, what is left of a body
continues in place, is left over

explanation.definitionFit: As a noun the word means a dead body; as a verb it means continues to be there.

clue.text: Pains grip sick Greek hero

indicators.note: to grip is to hold within, so the second word sits inside the first

parts.note: aches are pains
ill means sick

explanation.surface: Aches seize a sick hero of Greek legend.
explanation.definitionFit: The warrior of the Trojan War in Homer's Iliad is a famous hero of Greek myth.

clue.text: Join a number in this place

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
here means in this place

explanation.surface: Instructions to sign up someone at this location.
explanation.definitionFit: To stick to or become attached is to join; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Tempts a number to break rules

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for 50

indicators.note: to break the regulations here is to knock their letters out of order

explanation.surface: Something entices a crowd into breaking regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: To entice or attract is to tempt; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Take a girl out some fruit

definitions.meaning: go on a romantic outing with someone
the sweet fruit of a palm tree

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for a romantic outing and the name of a palm fruit.

clue.text: The way in which American financial interests operate

definitions.text: The way in which American financial interests operate

parts.words: The way in which American financial interests operate
parts.note: the way is a road, the New York street that houses the stock exchange and big banks

explanation.surface: A description of how US finance conducts its business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The way in which' reads as 'the manner in which', but 'way' is a street where the money men work.
explanation.definitionFit: The Manhattan street is home to the stock exchange and stands for US finance as a whole.

clue.text: Watch first man to take over — it's a surprise

parts.note: to eye something is to watch it
an opener is the first batsman in cricket, or simply the first one in

explanation.surface: Seeing the first player take over the bowling is unexpected.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the opener is one of the two batsmen who start an innings.
explanation.definitionFit: A revealing event that astonishes you is a surprise; the phrase is an idiom for one.

clue.text: I'd interrupted to stress something unintentional

indicators.note: interrupting something breaks into it, so these letters go inside the other word

parts.note: an accent is a stress on a syllable
taken as written, I and D

explanation.surface: Someone cut in to emphasise that it was not done on purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap that nobody meant to happen is unintentional by nature.

clue.text: Government official making conclusive changes

indicators.note: changes says the letters of the preceding word are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A civil servant introduces decisive reforms.
explanation.definitionFit: A deputy to a consul, posted abroad on behalf of a government, is a type of state official.

clue.text: Given to change, yet preventing its political implementation

indicators.note: change, said of the two opening words, means their letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A politician eager for reform still blocks it in practice.
explanation.definitionFit: Blocking a bill from becoming law is the act of using the power of rejection.

clue.text: Run and hide

definitions.meaning: an animal's skin with the fur on

explanation.walkthrough: 'Run and hide' reads as one escape, but each verb is a separate meaning and 'hide' is a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to rush along quickly and also an animal skin.

clue.text: Get browned off with a chap on the Circle Line

parts.note: to tan is to get browned by the sun
a gent is a chap

explanation.surface: A grumpy man riding the London Underground's Circle Line.
explanation.walkthrough: The Circle Line is a London Underground route; here the definition is a geometric line touching a circle.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry this straight line just touches a curve such as a circle at one point.

clue.text: You and I declare he's a man of the cloth

parts.note: you and I together are we
to aver is to declare

explanation.surface: We state that he is a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man of the cloth' usually means a priest; here it is someone who makes cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who makes fabric on a loom is literally a man of the cloth.

clue.text: Subject matter about right for a mundane circle

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the first word goes around the second

parts.note: a topic is subject matter

explanation.surface: The subject is suitable for discussing an ordinary social set.
explanation.definitionFit: Cancer and Capricorn name parallels of latitude, circles drawn on the earth's globe.

clue.text: Beat unconscious, then execute!

parts.note: someone knocked out is out cold
to do something is to execute it

explanation.surface: A violent sequence: knock someone out, then kill them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Execute' suggests killing; it means carry out.
explanation.definitionFit: To surpass someone in performance is to beat them; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Ageless saint and god

parts.note: Saint Peter, the apostle
Pan is the Greek god of the wild

explanation.surface: A timeless saint and deity.
explanation.definitionFit: J. M. Barrie's boy who never grows up is the byword for someone who never ages.

clue.text: Settled business

definitions.meaning: fixed, definite, not open to change

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective the word means fixed and definite; as a noun it is a company.

clue.text: Poor tip diner provided, showing no fear

indicators.note: poor says the following letters are in a bad, disordered state and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A restaurant customer leaves a stingy tip without a qualm.
explanation.definitionFit: A fearless, bold person is described as dauntless or courageous, synonyms of the word.

clue.text: Place to meet after a drive

indicators.note: after puts the meeting place behind the single letter

parts.note: a venue is a place where people meet

explanation.surface: A spot for getting together following a car journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drive' looks like a journey; it is a road name.
explanation.definitionFit: Drive and avenue are both words for a road, often tree-lined, used in street names.

clue.text: Such a girl presumably doesn't keep her boyfriends hanging about

definitions.text: Such a girl presumably doesn't keep her boyfriends hanging about

parts.words: Such a girl presumably doesn't keep her boyfriends hanging about
parts.note: a fun-loving pleasure-seeker is out for enjoyment, so she would not waste anyone's hours

explanation.surface: A light-hearted remark about a flirtatious girl's dating habits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doesn't keep them hanging about' plays on not wasting their hours, which is the literal reading of the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a pleasure-seeker, someone out to enjoy herself, as in a fun-loving partygoer.

clue.text: A company that floated to avoid liquidation ended up here

definitions.text: A company that floated to avoid liquidation ended up here

parts.words: A company that floated to avoid liquidation ended up here
parts.note: Noah's ark and its company floated to escape the flood and came to rest on this Turkish mountain

explanation.surface: A business floated on the market to dodge being wound up.
explanation.walkthrough: The financial words are a disguise: 'company' is Noah's party, 'floated' is literal, and 'liquidation' is drowning in the flood.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the ark came to rest on the mountains of this name after the flood.
